title: Term-Level Dossier-Extension Classification Record
description: Record class introduced by DISC-002 session 18 (ADR-0013): a term-level dossier-extension classification lists the knowledge units OUTSIDE the original dossier domain scopes that were judged to carry concept content for one domain term during corpus extension. Unlike overlap-classification records (schemas/overlap-classification.schema.json), these records are NOT pair-level cross-vault relationships: a single participating KU from a single vault is legitimate (the corpus-extension evidence may exist on one side only), so ku_ids has minItems 1 and there is no cross-vault requirement. The overlap_type carried on the record ('Complementary Content' for every session-18 record) describes how the extension evidence relates to the original dossier concepts, per ADR-0009 pair/record-level semantics.

task_id.description: Task that produced this classification (e.g. DISC-002).

topic.description: Human-readable term label, e.g. '<term> — corpus extension evidence'.

overlap_type.description: Relationship between the extension evidence and the original dossier concepts for the term. Record-level semantics (ADR-0009); stored separately from any KU disposition per docs/KNOWLEDGE_AND_PROVENANCE.md section 7.

ku_ids.description: Knowledge-unit ids carrying extension evidence for the term. A single KU is legitimate: corpus-extension evidence may exist in only one corpus location.

rationale.description: Why the ku_ids were judged to carry concept content for the term.

quote.description: Byte-exact excerpt of the KU supporting the decision.

lines.description: Inclusive source line numbers [line_start..line_end] of the KU's excerpt.

evidence.description: One entry per participating KU; verifiable against committed KU batches (ku existence, source_path, lines and byte-exact quote).

candidate_ref.description: Reference to the dossier-extension pair pool / run report that surfaced the term (provenance).

classified_by.description: Who/what assigned the classification (agent session, task, method).

method.description: How the decision was reached (e.g. 'ADR-0011 tiered dossier-extension classification').

supersedes_classification_id.description: Optional reference to a classification record this one supersedes.
